reviews.review: I have loved every minute I have spent playing this game with my friends. My friend runs a server for us and the bs we've gotten into is worth every penny, especially since it's pretty realistic for a war game. Would recommend buying a few copies for your friends too, if you don't have any really good friends who know every nuace of your personality that already play it. It can be a bit tough to learn the extra parts and how all the menus and loadouts work, but I've managed so far with out unknowingly bleeding out at attention.

Whomever decided that, after the split in Operation Flashpoint History happend, Bohemia Interactive Studio should focus on a new game series with the goal to maintain a near reality military simulator: May they be blessed!

Thanks to the rocky road the devs went, not giving up and not giving in to a massively arcade oriented market, we nowadays have what is called ArmA3, the probably most versatile, most supported and loved joined military simulator* available to the gaming community.

Here be also the time to send a MASSIVE "Thank You" to three teams that changed the arma community like none else and without said one would probably a lot less than what it is now:
* Community Base Addons Team (since ~2009)
* Advanced Combat Environment I, II & III (since ~2008)
* Advanced Combat Radio Environment / IDI-Systems (since ~2010)

The only one negative point I can state:
* ... The happening of "Make ArmA not War" Contest, which damaged the modding communities open mindset with such destructive force, like I could have never imagined.

* All you BF and CoD kiddos calling both franchises simulators, please 360, superjump, nochute yourselfs of a super high cliff :3

Myself:
I consider myself a long term ArmA Series player with round about 2500 hours on ArmA2 (untracked by steam due to different launcher) and 1500 hours on ArmA3. I have played the ArmA series since 2008, but since 2011 strongly oriented on 99% milsim-like gameplay with UnitedOperations, TacticalGamer and Tier1OPS.
Very good.  Really tense and exciting combat as well as an enormous selection of top notch addons, missions and campaigns. 10/10

This is the best game I ever played. If you ever searched for a realistic tatical game or a very good RP game this game is for you. I think that RP is the best part of this game because I had so much fun in RP and I really recommend this game to anyone that is searching for a new game. Ye
